The Prince of Cairo (Venrue... name begins with S... has hair like Marge
Simpson... I can't remember her name offhand!) tries to get a Heart of
Darkness, and uses a Daring the Dawn to bludgeon the action through.
Will she go to Torpor (assume full blood)?

I.e. when will the Heart of Darkness effect start to happen? Is it
instant, therefore before the damage from DtD resolves?

(As you can tell, I am away from home, so cannot refer to my usual
reference stuff)

Cheers guys...

DH

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
hamd...@my-deja.com wrote:
> The Prince of Cairo (Venrue... name begins with S... has hair like Marge
> Simpson... I can't remember her name offhand!) tries to get a Heart of
> Darkness, and uses a Daring the Dawn to bludgeon the action through.
> Will she go to Torpor (assume full blood)?
>
> I.e. when will the Heart of Darkness effect start to happen? Is it
> instant, therefore before the damage from DtD resolves?

Suhailah.

It happens when the action resolves. Which, by card text on DtD, is
before the damage from DtD is applied. So HoD will convert the
damage to normal.
